description: Repair the existing SwiftUI iOS target against the finalized FEAT-003 API contract. Replace missing external sources and ChatGPTSwift/Alamofire with local DTO/client/view-model/support code, preserve the existing visual assets, and provide Linux structural evidence plus macOS-only XCTest instructions.
steps: Remove every out-of-repository PBX source reference, ChatGPTSwiftAcharya/Alamofire framework/product/package reference, import, and stale /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/AcharyaGPT(iOS)/AcharyaGPT(iOS).xcodeproj/project.xcworkspace/xcshareddata/swiftpm/Package.resolved entry.

Add local ChatModels.swift and ChatAPIClient.swift that mirror POST /v1/chat and normalized errors, use injectable Foundation URLSession, read a non-secret backend URL from generated Info.plist, allow loopback HTTP only in Debug, and require HTTPS in Release.

Add @MainActor ChatViewModel.swift and SupportingViews.swift; update ChatbotView.swift for complete history pairs, blank/duplicate prevention, loading/cancel/retry/input retention, citations, grounding/abstention, warning/safety badges, and normalized errors while preserving assets, dark cards, progress, and auto-scroll.
Add an XCTest target with fixtures for success/citations, 422, 429, 502, 503, timeout, cancellation, malformed JSON, retry, and retained input using injected URLProtocol.

Add /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/scripts/validate_xcodeproj.py and pytest coverage to reject missing/external/package/secret references on Linux; run xcodebuild only if a macOS runner exists and otherwise record PENDING_MACOS_VALIDATION.
acceptance_criteria: Every PBX source/resource/test reference resolves inside /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild and the project has no remote package products or Alamofire/ChatGPTSwift import.
No provider credential or secret-like value is present in Swift sources, fixtures, assets, generated Info.plist settings, or application resources.
DTOs decode checked-in success/error fixtures including nullable scores and unknown warnings, and request history is empty or complete user/assistant pairs.

View-model tests cover success, citations, 422/429/502/503, timeout, cancellation, malformed JSON, retry and retained input; UI exposes loading, citations, grounding/abstention, safety, warning, and recoverable error states.
Linux structural validation passes. Xcode success is claimed only from an actual Xcode 15/iOS 17 macOS test artifact; otherwise the component remains PENDING_MACOS_VALIDATION.
verification: On macOS only: xcodebuild -project /projects/sandbox/AcharyaGPT/.worktrees/rag-rebuild/AcharyaGPT(iOS)/AcharyaGPT(iOS).xcodeproj -scheme AcharyaGPT(iOS) -destination platform=iOS\ Simulator,name=iPhone\ 15 test; on Linux record the test as PENDING_MACOS_VALIDATION rather than passed
findings: Completed in local commit c2ddb44. Rebuilt the iOS target entirely from in-repository Swift sources, removed all twelve external source references plus ChatGPTSwiftAcharya/Alamofire package products/imports, deleted Package.resolved, and added a shared app/test scheme. Added API-contract DTOs (including nullable dense/rerank scores and forward-compatible warning strings), an injectable Foundation URLSession client with normalized 422/429/502/503/timeout/cancellation/malformed-response errors, generated-Info.plist backend configuration, Debug-only loopback HTTP validation, and Release HTTPS enforcement. Added a @MainActor view model that limits history to ten complete user/assistant pairs, prevents blank/duplicate/in-flight submissions, retains failed input, and supports cancel/retry. Reworked the existing dark SwiftUI experience while preserving assets and exposing progress, citations, retrieval mode, grounding/abstention outcome, warning, safety, and recoverable-error states. Added an XCTest target with checked-in success/error fixtures and injected URLProtocol/stub coverage for success/citations, nullable scores, unknown warnings, 422/429/502/503, timeout, cancellation, malformed JSON, retry, retained input, blank/duplicate prevention, and complete message pairs. Structural evidence: validate_xcodeproj.py PASSED; Linux pytest structural suite 4 passed; full Python suite 52 passed; configured Ruff passed; strict mypy passed for 30 files; uv lock/sync passed; all Swift application/test sources passed Linux swiftc frontend parsing; shared scheme XML parsed; offline Gate A remained PASSED. Secret/package scanning found no provider credential, secret-like client value, forbidden import, remote package product, external PBX path, missing PBX file, or stale package lock. macOS status: PENDING_MACOS_VALIDATION because this Linux host has no xcodebuild; no Xcode build/test success is claimed. Later-step needs: run the documented Xcode 15/iOS 17 iPhone 15 simulator test on macOS and retain its artifact, then replace the non-secret Release placeholder https://api.example.invalid through build configuration with the deployed HTTPS backend URL; keep provider secrets server-side only.
